definitions.standard_listings: listings that pass the standard-property classifier; non-standard types (relocatable, leasehold-only, retirement etc.) are excluded
definitions.homes_avm: standard listings whose primary valuation range is the Homes.co.nz AVM shown on the Trade Me listing (standard listings only)
definitions.homes_avm_pct: homes_avm as a percentage of standard listings (standard listings only)
definitions.sold_comps: standard listings whose primary range comes from comparable sales, i.e. comp_cv_normalised + comp_absolute (standard listings only)
definitions.comp_cv_normalised: standard listings valued by the CV-normalised comparable-sales model (sale price / CV ratios; value_source 'sold_comps') (standard listings only)
definitions.comp_absolute: standard listings valued by the raw nearby-sales fallback (value_source 'sold_comps_absolute') (standard listings only)
definitions.active_guide: standard listings valued from the active suburb guide only (standard listings only)
definitions.hedonic_fallback: standard listings valued by the calibrated hedonic fallback model (standard listings only)
definitions.with_range_pct: share of standard listings with a complete low/mid/high value range (standard listings only)
definitions.all_listings.homes_avm: all collected listings whose primary range is a Homes.co.nz AVM, including non-standard ones (all collected listings; reference only)
definitions.all_listings.sold_comps: all collected listings with a comparable-sales range, including non-standard ones (all collected listings; reference only)
definitions.all_listings.active_guide: all collected listings valued from the active suburb guide, including non-standard ones (all collected listings; reference only)
definitions.mape_with_cv: mean absolute percentage error of the hedonic AVM under 5-fold cross-validation, as a fraction
definitions.median_ape_with_cv: median absolute percentage error of the hedonic AVM under 5-fold cross-validation, as a fraction
definitions.mape_no_cv: mean absolute percentage error of the no-CV hedonic variant, as a fraction
definitions.interval_level: nominal level of the reported prediction interval (0.8 = 80%)
definitions.median_value_mid: median of the primary value-range midpoints across standard listings
definitions.median_cv: median council capital value across standard listings
definitions.median_cv_ratio: median of per-listing value midpoint ÷ council CV, across standard listings where both exist (this is a median of ratios, not median value ÷ median CV)
definitions.mean_cv_ratio: arithmetic mean of per-listing value midpoint ÷ council CV, across standard listings where both exist (context only)
definitions.median_days_on_market: median days on market across standard listings
definitions.below_avm_count: standard listings asking below their primary value midpoint, counted only where the stored deal gap is reliable (high/medium confidence, non-leasehold)
definitions.below_avm_pct: below_avm_count as a percentage of standard listings
definitions.suburbs.median_value_mid: median primary value midpoint across the suburb's standard listings
definitions.suburbs.median_cv_ratio: median of per-listing value midpoint ÷ council CV, across this suburb's standard listings where both exist (not the suburb's median value ÷ median CV, which is lower when expensive homes have low CVs)
definitions.suburbs.mean_cv_ratio: arithmetic mean of per-listing value midpoint ÷ council CV for this suburb's standard listings (context only; median_cv_ratio is the comparable statistic)
definitions.suburbs.avm_pct: share of the suburb's standard listings whose primary range is the Homes.co.nz AVM
definitions.suburbs.trend_12w: change in the suburb median estimate over the stored 12-week window, as a fraction
definitions.top_value.ranking: standard listings, high/medium confidence, non-null deal gap; ordered by deal_gap_pct descending, then deal_gap descending, then days_on_market descending; top 6
definitions.top_value.value_low: lower bound of the listing's primary published value range (the range bound shown in the listing card)
definitions.top_value.value_mid: midpoint of the listing's primary published value range (the model-comparable estimate)
definitions.top_value.value_high: upper bound of the listing's primary published value range (the range bound shown in the listing card)
definitions.top_value.deal_gap: primary value midpoint minus asking price, in dollars
definitions.top_value.deal_gap_pct: the same gap as a percentage of the primary value midpoint
definitions.sale_methods.share_pct: share of standard listings using the sale method
definitions.coverage_by_type.avm_pct: share of standard listings of that property type whose primary range is the Homes.co.nz AVM
definitions.trend.weeks: nominal trend window in weeks; series holds the stored suburb snapshot dates inside that window
definitions.trend.series.week: a stored market snapshot date; the database captures suburb estimates fortnightly, not weekly
definitions.automation.last_run_at: start time of the last daily refresh run
definitions.research.fdr_tests: text-regression coefficients tested with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the two dependent variables
definitions.research.text_model_delta_pct: percentage-point change in cross-validated MAPE when text features are added to the structural model (negative = text improves the model)
definitions.generated_at: export time in the build host's local timezone (+13:00 NZDT)

sources.suburbs: /api/market, with group and AVM share from /api/listings cards
